# Sanctuary Architects & Designers

> Sanctuary Architects & Designers is an architecture and interior design studio based in Bangalore, India, founded in 2003 by Principal Architect Anshul Chodha. The practice designs luxury residential, hospitality, commercial and prefab architecture across India and abroad.

## Business details

- Name: Sanctuary Architects & Designers
- Founded: 2003
- Principal Architect: Anshul Chodha
- Address: 31, 4th Cross Road, 8th A Main Rd, Vinayaka Nagar, Sadashiva Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560080
- Phone: +91 98450 03452
- Email: anshul@sanctuaryarch.com
- Business Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM
- Website: https://www.sanctuaryarch.com/

## Services

- Architecture design
- Interior design
- Commercial design
- Hospitality design
- Master planning
- Prefab projects
